environment.description: Same Go WebSocket service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with a custom rate-based rule (threshold: 5 requests per 5-minute window per source IP for the /ws path) combined with a scope-down statement matching connection upgrade headers. Additionally, the ALB's fixed-response rule returns 429 for any request where the Host header does not match the registered CNAME (strict SNI enforcement via listener rule priority 1). The rate-based rule uses a forwarded-IP configuration reading X-Forwarded-For with fallback to source IP. The WAFv2 rule group also includes a custom regex pattern set that inspects the Origin header and blocks requests where Origin contains an IP address literal or any domain not in the explicit allow-list (regex: ^https://(app|dashboard)\.internal\.corp$). CloudWatch alarm triggers on RateBasedRule metric to invoke a Lambda that adds offending IPs to an IP set with BLOCK action.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 Web ACL association

waf_rules.name: ws-connection-rate-limit
waf_rules.scope_down: URI path /ws AND header Connection: Upgrade

config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, CNAME to ALB
config.network: private subnet, accessible only via VPN or internal network
config.adaptive_blocking: CloudWatch + Lambda IP-set updater on sustained rate violations
